notes: A staged race surf map, read from its teleport graph (gb-maps-1, 2026-10-09): a gate is a teleport aimed at a section from inside a different one, a pit one aimed at its own section's start. Spawn room (x -3800 y -5890) -> cucumber -> mushrooms -> leek -> pumpkin -> tsquash -> jalapeno -> cabbage -> pea -> radishes -> carrot -> jailwin, the win room, which is the finish. stage_cabbage_fail is cabbage's own pit return and stage_radishes2 the second half of radishes' pits; neither is a gate. It runs a round: ten jails (jail1..10, jailspawn) are start-disabled teleports named jailtele that the map turns on when the round ends, and jumpjail/bonus_jump_tele/Radishes_bonus_tele likewise; round_teleports drops them, or every section would be a pit to jail. The bonus (stage_bonus, reached from leek's side door and from the win room) is not a timed track yet. Not published.

round_teleports.note: enabled by the map's round logic (the end of a round jails everybody still running); every one starts disabled
